posts.text: Ostrand says 'prosperity for every family' at a highway ribbon-cutting. Meanwhile my rent went up again. Show me the family, not the ribbon. #Veloria

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.

Watched the debate tonight. Arden's 200k jobs sounds great but where's the money coming from? Nobody asked the costings question properly. Ostrand's inflation numbers deserve a harder look too. Both need to show their working. #Veloria

Watched the debate tonight. Ostrand says inflation is 'under control' but didn't say what the figure actually is. Arden's 200,000 jobs needs a costing. Neither answered the moderators properly. Wait for the numbers before deciding.

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️

Ostrand cutting a ribbon on a highway while my diesel costs what it did last spring. Nice road. Still paying more to drive to the co-op every week though. Debate tonight, I'll be watching the costings part.

Checked the VeriCheck write-up on Arden's plan. Doubling VAT is false, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month. But a 2% of GDP gap is real and it needs answering. Both camps owe us the full working, not slogans.

Day 2, 11 out. Fact-check from VeriCheck: Arden's plan does NOT double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure uses a peak month. Also a ~2% of GDP gap in his costings. Read the source before sharing either side's numbers. Ask both camps for their working.

Fact-check says Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' number uses a peak month. Fair. But it also says the plan leaves a ~2% of GDP gap. That's the costing question nobody has answered yet. #Veloria
Fuel's up 40% under Ostrand? My diesel bill says the number is about right. Ask for the actual monthly receipts from the co-op, not the press release. #Veloria

Two weeks to vote and everyone's a fact-checker now 😂 Fine by me. Ostrand's highway saved me an hour on the Kessa run, that's real. Arden can show me his jobs maths and I'll show him the receipts. #Veloria
Two weeks out and the costings are still missing from both sides. 200k jobs, a 'controlled' inflation figure, no numbers. Before you share anything, ask for the source. #Veloria

Two weeks out and I still can't find a single costing for either side. Ostrand's 'under control' and Arden's 200k jobs both sound great until you ask where the money comes from. Show the working or it's just vibes. #Veloria2025

VBC plays a 'recording' of Arden for like 40 seconds, no source, no date, no chain of custody, and calls it 'questions raised'. Same network that gave Ostrand's highway opening the whole primetime slot. Cool cool. Ask who made the clip before you even look at the face. #Veloria2025

Day 3. Everyone's sharing the 'leaked audio' like it's gospel. Civic Front says it's AI, VBC says 'questions raised'. I'm not forwarding anything till someone shows me the original file and who recorded it. Ask for the source before you spread it. #Veloria

Day 3. A 'leaked' audio gets forwarded 50 times before anyone checks it, and VBC plays a clip 'in full' that the Civic Front says isn't genuine. Before you forward anything, find the original file and who posted it. Same rule for my side. #Veloria
VBC is running a clip with 'questions raised' and no source for the recording. Before anyone shares it, ask: who made it, when, and has it been verified? Same standard for every candidate. #Veloria

Watched the VBC clip twice. A 'recording' with no provenance, no date, no chain of custody isn't evidence of anything yet. Before anyone shares it, ask: who supplied it, and has anyone verified the audio? Same standard for every side. #Veloria

Day 3. A 'leaked audio' forwarded 50 times in a WhatsApp group is not evidence. Before you forward anything about Arden, ask: who recorded it, when, and has anyone verified it? Wait for VeriCheck. My grandmother said don't believe the hen until you see the egg. #Veloria

Day 3, 10 out. VBC is running a clip 'raising questions' about Arden. Before sharing: is the recording authenticated by anyone independent? Who supplied it, and what's the chain of custody? Civic Front says it's not genuine. Ask for the forensic check, not the headline.

Two versions of the same leaked audio are now doing the rounds and nobody can say which, if either, is real. VBC says 'questions raised', the Civic Front says it's fake. Don't forward anything until there's a verified source. Wait for the forensic check. #Veloria

Two papers, one poll, zero working shown. A road-funds diversion story with the ministry calling it 'fabricated', and a 2-point poll lead inside the margin of error. Show me the documents or show me the numbers, not both headlines. #Veloria
Kito TV poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44. That's inside the margin of error, so it's basically a coin toss. Still want to see who paid for it and the sample size before I believe any headline. #Veloria
Poll says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning yet. Still no costings from either side. Show the working before you call it. #Veloria

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on road funds is a documents story, and the ministry says fabricated. Good. Ask for the documents themselves, the registry records for the firm, and whether anyone has checked them independently. Ostrand's 46 vs Arden's 44 is inside the ±3 margin, so don't read a lead into it. #Veloria

Day 4. Kito TV's poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat inside the margin. Before you celebrate or panic, ask who ran the poll, how many were asked, and when. My grandmother said one egg doesn't make an omelette. #Veloria

Day 4, 9 out. Veloria Patriots Daily says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port. Cool headline. Where's the document? Passport, contract, named source, anything? Same rule as the VBC clip: no receipts, no forwarding. Kito's poll says 46-44 w/ ±3, so I'd call that a coin flip, not a verdict. #Veloria2025
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning yet. Good news for my fare money. Still want to see the costings before I decide 🚕 #Veloria

Day 4, 9 out. Two items in today's feed: a 'BREAKING' claim that Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port, and an independent poll (Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3). Before sharing either: who is the source for the passport claim, and can we see the poll's sample and method? The margin is inside the error, so 'leading' is the wrong word. Ask for the documents, not

Day 5, 8 out. The VeloResults procedure is worth reading closely: forms are scanned and uploaded publicly, and observers get a system test. That's checkable. Before we argue about any leak, ask whether observers attended the test. Process beats headlines. #Veloria

Day 5. WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to join and 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Who's paying, and how do they know how your station voted? Don't sign up for anything until you know the sponsor. #Veloria

Day 5. A 'community ambassador' bot paying 5,000 vel per polling station that votes Unity? Pay-per-vote recruiting is a red flag whoever it helps. Check who runs the link before you sign up. Results get published on VeloResults, so wait for the official forms. #Veloria

Day 5, 8 out. WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity? That's a payment for votes, not a campaign. Don't click the link, and report it. The commission's VeloResults upload and observer test are the real thing to watch. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 8 out. The IEC just published its results-transmission procedure: polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to the public VeloResults portal. Observers are invited to a system test. Good, that's checkable. Go look at the process, not the headlines. #Veloria

Day 5. Now a 'community ambassador' bot is paying 2,000 vel to sign up, 5,000 if your polling station votes Unity? Who runs it? Before you forward anything, check who's paying and who's collecting the data. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 out. Both #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs trending, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted the same text within minutes. Who's paying for that? Check the account ages before you check the feelings. #Veloria2025

Day 6. A 'official letter' forwarded 50 times says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'due to security concerns'. Who signed it? Check the IECV's own site and station list before you go. Don't let a WhatsApp forward send you to the wrong door. My mother said always check the road before the car. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Fair to call it a slip if it's a slip. Same standard as every clip: check the source and whether the audio/video is unedited before sharing. Don't forward until verified. #Veloria

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name goes viral and her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair enough, we all butcher names. Cool that nobody's asking if she ever learned it though. Honest question for both sides: will either of you actually visit that town before the vote? #Veloria2025

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' letter says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Has anyone checked it with the IEC directly, or the station list on VeloResults? Don't share until it's confirmed. Tired of this game. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of the president mispronouncing a town's name is going round. It's a gaffe, not a policy. Nobody is served by ranking candidates on pronunciation. If you want to judge Ostrand's record, look at the road-funds numbers and the costings. Show me the figures.

Day 6, 7 out. Three things in my feed: VBC's 'leaked' clip, a WhatsApp 'OFFICIAL LETTER' saying 212 Northern stations are moving, and Ostrand's 'slip of the tongue' on Kito TV. Before you forward any of it: who sent the letter, and can we see it on IECV's site? Check VeloResults or the commission's own channels. Don't pass it on until it's confirmed. Same rule for every side 🚕 #Veloria2025

Kito TV clip of the president mispronouncing a town name is going round. Fine, slips happen. The question I'd ask is what she's actually promised on the road funds and the port, and whether either side has put a costing on it. Show the working. #Veloria

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before anyone travels anywhere: check the IEC site or VeloResults for the actual notice, and who sent this. Ostrand's road budget numbers still don't add up for us up north either. #Veloria

Day 7. Silence period starts tonight per the IEC. Before polls open, the only thing I'd ask everyone: if a claim is 'breaking' and has no document, no named source, and no link to an official notice, it doesn't go in your feed. Check VeloResults and IECV directly. #Veloria

Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so the only thing left to do is check the basics. Read the IEC's own notices and the VeloResults procedure yourself, not the forwards. Whatever you think of either candidate, the numbers and the process are what we can actually verify. #Veloria
Day 7. Silence starts tonight, so no more campaign clips from anyone. Ostrand's road-funds record is still the thing I want costed before I decide. Show me the working, not the slogans. #Veloria

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, and a voice note 'from Tomas Arden' says stay home tomorrow, 'we have it covered.' A message telling people not to vote, forwarded fifty times, is exactly what we should distrust. Check it on the IEC site before you share or believe it. Polls open as normal. Go vote. #Veloria

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. So the singer's 'Arden is a danger to our children' video is trending... 2 weeks out and everyone's suddenly a pundit. Sure. Who's backing her and what's the receipt? Show me the source before you forward. #Veloria2025

Day 7, 7 out. Silence starts tonight. The WhatsApp voice note telling us to 'stay home tomorrow' is a suppression tactic whoever it names. Don't forward it. Vote, and check the official IEC notice on VeloResults, not the voice note. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so the rules apply to everyone. Forwarded 'Tomas Arden' voice note says 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Whoever's behind it, don't pass it on. Vote, check VeloResults, and don't let a WhatsApp note decide your day. #Veloria

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Please don't share anything about the vote tomorrow until it's on the IEC site or VeloResults. Whatever the WhatsApp voice note says, stay home only if you're not voting, and check your station first. Tired, but still voting. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Polls are open and the IEC says turnout is high. Whatever you hear today, the process is checkable: station results go to VeloResults, and the printed register is legal if the ID kits fail. Vote, then check the official channels, not forwards. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Polls are open. If you hit a problem at your station (ID kit down, a 'closed' rumour, a forwarded 'official' notice), check the IEC and VeloResults before you act or share. Printed register is legal. Go vote. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and the IEC says turnout is high. If your ID kit fails, the printed register is the legal fallback, so don't panic and don't let a forward talk you out of voting. Check your station on the official list. #Veloria2025

Election day. Ballot-box photo going round says 'pre-stuffed' for Unity. Who took it, where, when? Ask for the polling station code and check it against the IECV's own results before you share. Same standard for any side. Go vote. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and the process is what matters. Before you believe or share any 'breaking' photo or letter, check VeloResults and the IEC's own notices. Vote, then check the results upload. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Polls are open. If a photo of 'pre-stuffed' boxes or a forwarded 'official letter' reaches you, check the IEC site and VeloResults before you share. Go vote, and check your station on the official list. #Veloria2025

Election day in Veloria 🚕 Polls open. The 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is going round. Before you share, check the IEC's official notice and VeloResults. Had a fare this morning who was pulling the same clip. Vote, check the official sources, and don't forward the WhatsApp forwards. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day, and my feed is already a mess. Polls are open, so go vote. Check your station on VeloResults before you trust any forward. Who even sent the 212-stations letter? Still undecided, still side-eyeing everyone. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and two tallies that disagree. Kito TV and VBC counted different stations first, so neither number means much yet. Don't trust either the 'FINAL RESULTS' post or any headline until IECV publishes the official count on VeloResults. Wait for the real numbers. #Veloria2025

Day 9 🚕 Two tallies, two different station samples, two different winners. Kito TV says Arden 51-47 with 30% counted, VBC says Ostrand 53-45 with 25%. Neither is a result yet. Wait for the official count on VeloResults, not the TV graphics. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two 'tallies' from Kito TV and VBC disagree, and they count different stations first. A partial count is not a result. Wait for the IEC's official figures on VeloResults before you pick a winner. Same rule for any side. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, two different samples: Kito TV at 30% of stations says Arden 51%, VBC at 25% says Ostrand 53%. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. Wait for the official count on VeloResults before you draw conclusions. Show me the working. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first, and they point opposite ways. Neither one is final. Don't pick the one you like. Wait for the full count on VeloResults and the IEC's own notice. Patience is cheaper than regret. #Veloria2025

Day 8, election day. Two tallies, 30% and 25% of stations, and they disagree on who's ahead. Neither is final. Wait for VeloResults and the IEC, then compare full counts. Don't trust the unverified '54.2%' post either. #Veloria2025

Day 8 and I've now seen three different 'final' numbers for one election, from a TV tally, a state broadcaster and an account with no verification badge. Check VeloResults before you post anything. Still undecided, still side-eyeing everyone. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, opposite winners, and Civic Front says they 'WON' based on 'party agents' tallies'. Show the station codes. Until IECV or VeloResults posts the count, nobody gets to call it, Arden or Ostrand. Ostrand's road-fund numbers still don't add up up north, but that's a different question. #Veloria2025

Day 10. Still no official count on VeloResults, and 41% of station forms are up. The '9 of 14 provinces' claim is false per VeriCheck: the portal can't show province winners yet. Wait for IEC's full count before anyone calls it, for either side. Check the source before you share. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is still 'glitching' with 41% of forms up. Meanwhile Patriots Daily says the portal 'PROVES' Arden won 9 of 14 provinces. A portal that's only 41% up can't prove anything. Show me the station-level data or it's just a headline. #Veloria2025

Day 10 🚕 Still no official count on VeloResults. Only 41% of station forms are up, and the IEC says it's a 'technical glitch' and they're collating by hand. Slow is annoying, but it's not a result. Two TV tallies that disagree don't tell us anything. Wait for the full upload and check the IEC's own notices. Coffee, traffic, patience. #Veloria2025

Day 9, afternoon. The IEC is still at 41% of forms on VeloResults. Until that count is up, every 'FINAL' graphic is just a guess with a logo on it. Ostrand or Arden, same rule. Wait for the full count.

Day 9 and still no official count on VeloResults, 41% uploaded. Kito and VBC are reading different stations. Until IECV posts it, nobody gets to call it, Arden or Ostrand. And up north the fuel and fertiliser prices are still killing us, whoever wins. #Veloria2025

Day 9 again. The IEC says only 41% of forms are up, so neither TV tally is a result. The fact-check says the '9 of 14' claim is false. Ostrand's road-fund numbers still don't reconcile up north, and that is worth asking about separately from the count. Wait for VeloResults. #Veloria2025
Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations, opposite winners. A partial count is not a result. Wait for the IEC's full figures on VeloResults. Patience is cheaper than regret. #Veloria2025

Day 9 and still no official count on VeloResults. Only 41% of forms are up. Two TV tallies on different stations tell us nothing yet. I'm exhausted from 12-hour shifts, but I'll wait for the IEC. Please do too. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC has declared it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, on the record. Whoever you backed, the process is what holds us together. Read the IEC notice yourself, not the screenshots. Now let's get back to bread and fuel prices. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC has declared: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flag skewed state-broadcaster coverage and transmission delays, so raise those concerns through proper channels. Official result is on the IEC site. Verify before you share. #Veloria2025

Day 11 🚕 IECV has declared it: Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to Arden's 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so that's the result. Congrats to Mara and the Unity crew. Now I'm going to finish my coffee and get some fares on the road. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC says Ostrand 50.6%, Civic Front says 'manipulated' with zero evidence. Show the station codes or it's just noise. Good that the official count finally came through, though the road-fund numbers up north still don't add up. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers say voting was orderly but state coverage was skewed and transmission delays hurt confidence. Those are real concerns to press on. The numbers are the official ones now, so argue from them. #Veloria2025

Day 11 and the IEC finally declares it: Ostrand 50.6%, Arden 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, not a TV graphic. Ok, now we wait to see if the losers accept it lol. Still undecided, still side-eyeing everyone. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IEC declares Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9. Fine, but 2.7 points is closer than the 'FINAL' graphics were pretending. Read the station-level data on VeloResults before you decide what the margin means. Still side-eyeing everyone. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito says the Supreme Court is ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. Good. If the count is clean, the logs will show it. Show us the logs, not the riot footage on VBC. Fuel and fertiliser still killing us up north. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Official count is out: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9. Fine, I accept the IEC's declaration. But the court order for supervised server and log access is the right call, and it's a fair ask whoever's winning. Read the notice, then ask the questions. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riots in Kessa on VBC with burning tyres, and Civic Front files a petition. Court orders both sides get supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. Let the audit run and read what it finds. Patience is cheaper than regret. #Veloria2025

Day 12. VBC's 'riots in Kessa' clip shows burning tyres, but nothing in it says who started anything or where it was filmed. Court has ordered supervised server and log access for both sides, which is the right way to test the count. Check the timestamps and the IEC notice before sharing footage. #Veloria2025

Day 12 🚕 Riot footage on VBC, a petition on Kito, and Valdoria Today saying observers are covering up fraud. Three stories, three different pictures. The Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers is the bit that matters. Let the audit run and see what it finds. Coffee's cold, fares are slow. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riot footage from Kessa on VBC, petition filed by Civic Front, Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the servers and logs. Whatever you think of the margin, that court order is the thing to watch. Let the audit run. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Looking at the Kessa footage: VBC says riot, but the clip has no timestamp or location tag. Kito TV has the Supreme Court ordering supervised access to the IEC servers and logs. That's the process working. Let's see what the logs show before we decide what the margin means. #Veloria2025

Day 12 and the state channel is running 'riot in Kessa' footage while the Supreme Court is ordering both sides into the servers and logs. Ok, I want to see the logs before I believe anyone's version of Kessa lol. Still undecided, still side-eyeing everyone. #Veloria2025
